name: Group
summary: Visually groups closely related items without a heading (proximity).

label.description: Accessible name for the group when it isn't obvious from its content

arrangement.description: Hint only. 'inline' for a few short peers (e.g. metrics); renderers stack on narrow screens.

whenToUse: A few items that belong together (a key figure and its caption, several metrics)
whenNotToUse: The group needs a heading: use Section
Choosing between items: use Choice or Comparison

requirements: Has an accessible name when it contains interactive items

agent: Treated as one unit when its label is present.
rendering: 'inline' collapses to a stack below the compact breakpoint

mappings.web: <div role=group> with flex/grid and semantic spacing tokens
